Hi Lucia —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up-front: portal-first; email allowed as fallback but requires a subject token and filename convention; we accept multi-row CSVs. Below is a minimal checklist you can share with AP.

Quick checklist (recommended):
- Preferred: submit via Supplier Portal (gives automatic acks, PO-linking UI, and faster processing).
- Fallback: email to invoices@redwood-invoice.com with subject: "ACME-ONBOARD|<vendor_id>|<account_id>" (we'll provide the exact token after onboarding).
- Filename convention (email fallback): acme_<vendor_id>_<YYYYMMDD>_<batch_id>.csv
- CSV minimal columns (header names are case-insensitive):
  - invoice_number
  - invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  - vendor_id (your vendor identifier)
  - po_number (blank allowed but include when available; recommended to match PO stamping policy)
  - line_items (JSON array or pipe-delimited string — see note)
  - currency (ISO 4217, e.g., USD)
  - net_amount (numeric)
  - tax_amount (numeric, 0.00 allowed)
  - total_amount (numeric)
  - remit_to_entity
  - payment_terms (e.g., Net30)

Notes and constraints:
- We prefer PO number present for automated matching. If missing, the invoice will route to manual queue and processing will be slower.
- Line items: for portal submissions you can use structured line item rows. For email CSVs, include a single quoted field 'line_items' with each item separated by a pipe (|) and item fields separated by semicolons, e.g. "SKU123;2;199.99|SKU456;1;99.95".
- Multi-invoice CSV: accepted (one invoice per CSV row). We recommend no more than 500 rows per upload to keep ack times within SLA.
- Ack SLA: portal = immediate (within 5 min), email fallback = 4 business hours for initial ingestion ack.
- PO stamping: we can stamp PO on the invoice if your ERP sends the PO in the po_number field; otherwise item-level matching may require additional metadata and delay.

Action items for Acme to get live by week of 7/19:
1) Return the completed onboarding form (attached) with your vendor_id assignment.
2) Send a sample CSV using the filename convention above to invoices@redwood-invoice.com so we can validate ingest mapping.
3) Confirm whether you will integrate Portal (preferred) or continue with email fallback.

I've attached a very small sample CSV we use for validation. Looping in Vanessa and Jordan for any region-specific limits or follow-ups.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
